guide.summary: Dissolved food that spreads through water.
guide.biology: Simple sugars dissolve and drift; many microbes can use them directly.
guide.rules: Adds sugar carbon to each painted cell. It diffuses: fast in water, slowly in gel and very slowly in sediment. Carries no minerals, so eaters also need mineral nutrients to grow.
guide.example: A small sugar patch near Sprinters starts a feeding frenzy.
